#4 Heartwood Tree

The Heartwood Tree first took root on the very day of Theodora Thurgens' coronation, its emergence whispered as omen and blessing alike. Its roots plunge deeper than any heartwood known across Verra, piercing the stone layers until they reach the radiant wells of liquid Essence far beneath. From this unseen font, the tree draws sustenance enough not only for itself, but for the city it anchors, the dwarvish lifeblood it shelters, and the great machinery that binds their civilization in motion.
